description: This file defines an 'Indenter' class used for managing indentation of code snippets in various formats (JSON, C++, manual, etc.), with methods for processing and applying indentation rules based on file type and content.

classes.name: Indenter
classes.description: A class for handling indentation of code snippets in different formats, including C++, JSON, and manual indentation, with methods to process and apply indentation rules.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes indentation settings and mode flags.

methods.name: indentType
methods.description: Determines the indentation style based on file extension and filename.

methods.name: _collapseBlank
methods.description: Collapses multiple blank lines into a single blank line.

methods.name: _indentCPP
methods.description: Applies C++ style indentation rules to a list of code lines.

methods.name: _indentJSON
methods.description: Applies JSON style indentation rules to a list of code lines.

methods.name: _indentManual
methods.description: Applies manual indentation based on special markers.

methods.name: processIndent
methods.description: Main method to process a code string and return it with proper indentation based on current mode.
